comment: A test (quiz/exam) belonging to a course, with a possible and required score.

columns.name: campus_id
columns.comment: Campus this course test belongs to.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Surrogate identifier for the course test, auto-generated by the database and unique across the whole system.

columns.name: code
columns.comment: Human-readable test code, unique within its course (the same code may be reused on a different course).

columns.name: active
columns.comment: Whether this test is currently open/available.

columns.name: test_questions
columns.comment: Optional test question text, capped at 4000 characters (SQL Server's largest non-MAX NVARCHAR size) rather than using the unbounded text type.

columns.name: possible_score
columns.comment: Maximum score achievable on this test.

columns.name: required_score
columns.comment: Minimum score required to pass this test.
